source.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board, Rent Stabilization Ordinance (BMC ch. 13.76, as amended by Measure BB)

newConstruction.quote: Newly Constructed Rental Units. A rental unit created after June 30, 1980.

estimate.rule: a parcel with more than two units (city parcel layer) built in or before 1980
estimate.note: An estimate. Berkeley publishes no parcel-level rent registry. Year built is a year, so 1980 buildings count though some may be newer than the June 30, 1980 cutoff; it cannot tell whether tenants occupied a unit in the past seven years, which units are exempt for other reasons, or whether the unit count is current.
